description_en: Queries the monitoring data in a namespace
description_zh: 调用DescribeHybridMonitorDataList接口查询指定指标仓库中的监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-hybrid-monitor-data-list --namespace default-aliyun --prom-sql AliyunEcs_cpu_total --start 1653804865 --end 1653805225 --period 60 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridMonitorDataList

parameters.help_en:
The name of the namespace.

parameters.help_zh:
